hard_gates: Queue row is not a card.
Survey mention is recall evidence, not paper evidence.
No original paper PDF/HTML brief, no formal L1 card.
Formal L1 cards in notes/ root must pass scripts/autoresearch.py validate before being reported as complete.
select_rules: Core contribution changes on-policy teacher supervision or rollout distribution in multi-turn agent interaction.
Direct diagnosis or evaluation of agentic OPD mechanisms with original evidence.
maybe_rules: General OPD or offline agent distillation that supplies a necessary baseline; retain as adjacent/background.
move_elsewhere_rules: Pure reward/policy optimization goes to agentic-rl; data pipeline contributions go to agent-data; general OPD goes to opd.
